name: diagram-design
hook: Trending with 582 stars today (69.7k total) — an agent skill that draws any of 51 editorial diagram types as a single self-contained HTML+SVG file, with no build step. Brand colours and fonts are pulled from your site on first run, so every diagram matches your design system automatically.

name: Astryx Design System
hook: Meta's internal design system — 150+ accessible React 19 components, now open-source and 'agent ready': running `npx @astryxdesign/cli init` writes your project's CLAUDE.md so Claude builds with Astryx components instead of guessing. 31.7k stars, 4,131 gained this week. Grew inside Meta for 8 years, powers 13,000+ apps.
install:
npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex
npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli
npx @astryxdesign/cli init

name: Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM)
hook: Google Labs plugin for design and code review: the 'elephant' agent holds full context and drafts specs; fresh 'goldfish' reviewer subagents examine the draft cold, exposing unstated assumptions before you approve. 21.9k stars. Slash commands include /egm:draft, /egm:review, /egm:drift-report (compares docs to current source).
install:
claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
claude plugin install egm@egm

name: Claude Code v2.1.330
hook: Shipped Nov 20. Headline feature: Easel mod — a built-in mod that draws charts when you ask and auto-renders charts under MCP metrics results, available on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise (macOS/Linux). Also adds enterprise sign-in via `claude auth login`, `/fork` and `/workflows` commands in VS Code, and a `--start-dir` flag for self-hosted runners.

name: Modern Web Guidance
hook: Official Google Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN joint project: 262 modern web platform features and 204 real-world use cases packaged as an agent skill, so coding agents steer away from legacy patterns automatically. 9.8k stars, 5,224 gained this week. Runs `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install` and injects targeted guidance into the agent's context window as it works.

name: CLI-Anything
hook: Trending with 767 stars today (61.9k total). A 7-phase pipeline that generates a full Python CLI + REPL + JSON output + SKILL.md from any software codebase or repo, making it agent-native. CLI-Hub is the companion registry with ready-made CLIs for GIMP, Blender, LibreOffice, and Zotero. The meta-skill lets agents browse and install CLIs on their own.

name: ffmpeg-skill
hook: 9.2k stars, 3,268 this week. A local video-editing skill that exposes 42 FFmpeg tools to Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex — no cloud API required. Covers cuts, silence removal, 9:16 reframing, loudness normalization, HDR-to-SDR, green-screen, karaoke captions, and YouTube/Reels/TikTok delivery presets. An MCP server exposes every tool to any MCP client.

name: Claude Trading Skills
hook: 7.6k stars, 3,471 this week. A research and decision-process toolkit for equity investors: market regime analysis, VCP/CANSLIM/Stockbee-style screeners, position sizing, drawdown circuit-breaker, trade journaling, options strategy simulation, and earnings analysis — all as Claude Skills. A five-skill starter path runs without paid APIs using public CSVs and chart screenshots.

name: OpenSRE
hook: Trending with 450 stars today (13.9k total). An open-source CLI agent for CI/CD reliability in public alpha: when a CI run fails, it reads the logs, traces the cause, separates code failures from CI flakes, and pushes a fix to the PR branch for review. Posts summaries to Slack, PagerDuty, or Telegram. Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.

name: Astra Security MCP
hook: Official press release Nov 18. Connects Astra's autonomous pentesting platform to Claude Code (and GitHub Copilot, Cursor) via a hosted MCP server: query exploit-validated findings, start and schedule scans, triage vulnerabilities, generate reports, and get code-specific fixes — all from within the agent session. Single browser-auth setup.
install: claude mcp add --transport http astra https://mcp.getastra.com/mcp
